summary: Who was worse? Dershowitz, protector of pedophiles, litigator who argued for #impeachment 20 years arguing against impeachment? Ken Starr, the man who investigated a 20 year old land deal and turned it into impeachment over lying about adultery? Pam Bondi, corrupt FL prosecutor who gets a 25k donation from Trump and drops the Trump University investigation?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Who was worse?

Dershowitz, protector of pedophiles, litigator who argued for #impeachment 20 years arguing against impeachment?

Ken Starr, the man who investigated a 20 year old land deal and turned it into impeachment over lying about adultery?

Pam Bondi, corrupt FL prosecutor who gets a 25k donation from Trump and drops the Trump University investigation?
